article.title: The Attention Economy Navigator, August 2026
article.author: Cayden Mak
article.content: This month on the Attention Economy Navigator, our guide to what you should be paying more attention to, and what you can probably pay less attention to. And why those stories might not be what you’d assume. You can also listen to the podcast episode featuring Akin Olla and Josh Elstro, or watch the panel plot these stories in real time on YouTube.
